SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100 Futures Rise As BEA Pegs Q3 GDP At 4.4%— Microsoft, Moderna, Intel In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures rose on Thursday following Wednesday's gains, with major indices climbing over 1% after President Trump withdrew planned EU tariffs following a meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. Key stocks in focus include Intel reporting quarterly earnings, Microsoft announcing a partnership with Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, Moderna surging on positive cancer therapy study results, and Micron gaining on AI-driven memory chip demand.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
